title: From Natural Language to Verified C: Verification-Guided Generation with ACSL Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2610.30725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-assisted code generation amplifies the demand for automated formal verification. Generated programs must not only be executable but also accompanied by machine-checkable evidence of correctness. Existing approaches can synthesize functionally plausible code or plausible-looking specifications from natural-language prompts; however, they do not explicitly co-design the implementation and specification as a unified artifact optimized for verification. Consequently, automated verifiers often fail to discharge proof obligations. Typical failure modes include missing or implicit proof anchors, program structures that are hostile to automated reasoning, and inconsistencies between code-level state and specification-level requirement facts arising from the independent generation of code and specifications. Even when verification succeeds, it may only establish weak specifications that omit requirement-critical behavior. This paper introduces

translated_title: 从自然语言到经验证的C代码：基于ACSL规范的验证引导式生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：AI辅助代码生成放大了对自动化形式化验证的需求。生成的程序不仅要可执行，还必须附带机器可检查的正确性证据。现有方法可以从自然语言提示中合成功能上看似合理的代码或表面上合理的规范；然而，这些方法并未将实现与规范作为一个针对验证优化而设计的统一产物进行显式协同设计。因此，自动验证器往往无法完成证明义务。典型的失败模式包括：缺失或隐式的证明锚点、对自动推理不友好的程序结构，以及由于代码与规范独立生成而导致的代码级状态与规范级需求事实之间的不一致。即使验证成功，也可能仅建立了忽略关键需求行为的弱规范。本文提出了……
tldr: 该论文提出一种验证引导式生成方法，将C代码实现与ACSL规范作为统一产物进行协同设计，使AI生成的程序能够通过自动形式化验证并获得机器可检查的正确性证据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a verification-guided generation approach that co-designs C implementations and ACSL specifications as a unified artifact, enabling AI-generated programs to pass automated formal verification with machine-checkable correctness evidence.
